edit.find: movement chains 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 on X and one less on Y, removed when Y reaches $FF. The loop would end at once for a negative Y step, so it must move down.
edit.with: movement chain 4 or 8 on X and 3 or 7 on Y (the speed bits come from RNG x 2, whose bit 0 is 0, so the chains 6 and 10 never occur), removed when Y reaches $FF. X and Y are screen coordinates: the sprite is drawn at the actor position without the camera offset. Every tick the firefly moves 2 px left and 2 px down (chains 4 / 3) or 4 px left and 4 px down (chains 8 / 7), a down-left diagonal. X = RNG x 2 reaches 510, so about half of the fireflies start off the right edge of the 256 px screen and drift in. The Y test runs once per animation pass of 21 ticks: a 2 px firefly lives 147 ticks (it dies at Y = 294), a 4 px firefly 84 ticks (Y = 336).

edit.find: Not traced: the tile graphics these sub-sprites draw.
edit.with: The sub-sprites draw tiles $40-$6F of sprite name table 0 (VRAM word $4400-$46FF): LoadPlayerGraphics copies 1536 bytes (48 tiles) of misc_fx_1CCA80 there when sceneCurrent is $E8 and playerFlags bit 3 is clear. The art is a flame bird. The East and West groups (tile words $4440-$4464 and $0440-$0464) show it from the side with the 16x16 tiles $40, $42, $44, $46 and the 8x8 tiles $60-$64; the North and South groups (tile words $0448-$044E, $0468, $0469 and their flipped forms) show it from the front with the 16x16 tiles $48, $4A, $4C, $4E (the last one twice, mirrored) and the 8x8 tiles $68 and $69 (each twice, mirrored). The three frames of a launch animation use the same tiles; only the sub-sprite offsets grow. The palette is OBJ palette 2 (CGRAM colours $A0-$AF, loaded from palette_1E6273 by scene_meta_00E8); the tiles $65-$67 and $6A-$6F are loaded but drawn by no group. The art that scene_meta_00E8 loads into VRAM word $5000 (gfx_0D2D78, sprite name table 1) is not used by these sub-sprites.
